current.text: Clifford is projected to come off the bench. The projected Kings starters are Acuff, LaVine, Murray, Simmons and Sabonis.
He is in the Kings rotation, but his play is very inconsistent.
Sacramento could give some of Malik Monk's bench minutes to Clifford.
The Kings are one of the worst teams in the NBA. Poor coaching, ownership and front office make their rotations hard to predict.
Avoid him. There is no reason to be interested in him this season.
He was only average in summer league at age 24.5. Lloyd worries he will not stick in the NBA.

durable.text: Experts see him as a poor shooter. Teammates' assist numbers suffered because he could not hit shots, and he shot 41.8% from the field last season.
The expert calls him a good steals player. Projections still put his steals at only about the average for the top 250 pool.

note: Clifford is not a draft target. Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD, with ranks of 205 and 219. Our 144-player draft ends well before that, and the newest expert note says to avoid him. Projections have him below the pool average in almost every category, including 9.8 points on 44% shooting. His steals are only average, so he does not fit any punt build. Leave him on waivers, and look again only if Kings trades or injuries push his minutes well above last season's 25.1.
